title: hemizonia multiglandulosa var. cephalotes
intro: Hemizonia multiglandulosa var. cephalotes, commonly known as California goldfields, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. It is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States, specifically in the coastal regions of California. California goldfields is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is valued for its ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of California goldfields include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
